name: gain
description: The structured middle of a copy-paste loop between AI-authored training plans and the person following them.

scripts.check:chars: if git ls-files -z '*.ts' '*.js' '*.md' '*.json' '*.yml' '*.yaml' '*.css' '*.html' '*.svelte' | xargs -0 grep -laP '[\x00-\x08\x0B\x0C\x0E-\x1F\x7F]'; then echo 'Literal control characters in the files above. Write them as escapes (\u0000) — a raw one makes git treat the file as binary, and a file with no reviewable diff is a file nobody reviews.' >&2; exit 1; fi
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run check && npm run lint && npm run check:chars && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build
